Bundled text recognition so scanning works offline and without a CDN.

- tesseract.min.js, worker.min.js: tesseract.js 5.1.1 (Apache-2.0), https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
- tesseract-core-*.wasm.js: tesseract.js-core 5.1.1 (Apache-2.0)
- eng.traineddata.gz: tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best English LSTM model (Apache-2.0)
